cases.description:
The `pretrained_vectors` argument is passed to the `spacy.HashEmbedCNN.v1` function because that function takes all the arguments to the embedding and encoding layers together, because it builds them both. The `spacy.Tok2Vec.v1` layer takes in the embedding and encoding layers as arguments, so we don't have this config option.
